translations.web: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: And you are to place pure frankincense near each row, so that it may serve as a memorial portion for the bread, a food offering to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
